versions.notes: Download of the 3D simulator 3D-2.5: more realistic camera pictures (grain at night, raindrops on the lens, insects in the light at night - real false alarms to test); game: one player can be the guard (sees through the head camera), stones to distract, crystals to collect, lives, a microphone hears running; the referee works like a real detection.

3D simulator 3D-2.3: it only calculates while its window is open or Motion Watch is connected (saves power); its small box shows the CPU of the whole computer, of Motion Watch and of the simulator (Motion Watch measures and sends it).

3D simulator 3D-2.0 (big update): toolbar, search and «Einfach | Experte» like Motion Watch; visitors as small pictures to drag into the world; people and animals walk around objects; smoother movement, finer objects, grass and flowers; new visitors (child, jogger, hare, hedgehog, dog walk, deer herd, birds); new visitor settings (also here in the simulator control).

The download of the 3D simulator for Windows (ZIP) is now a button right under «Search now» in the simulator section (before hidden under Tools); the desktop window shows its address for the PC browser in the simulator line.

Tools: «Full power for the tools» - Motion Watch rests for 10 to 120 minutes (camera, detection, AI, extra cameras; a recording is finished first), the web page and the tools keep running; it comes back by itself or with «Resume now».
Download of the 3D simulator 3D-1.4: it starts without sending; the switch «An Motion Watch senden» in its window turns sending on.

Tools page redesigned, calmer: list of the tools on the left (with status), one tool at a time on the right; on a phone first the list, then the tool with a back button. Plain line icons, switches instead of check boxes, no empty boxes.
The 3D simulator for Windows can be downloaded from the Pi: /sim/simulator3d.zip (button under Simulator → Tools).

Second Wi-Fi adapter (USB stick): repeater (own Wi-Fi + internet from another network at the same time), change to another known network when the internet is gone, push message when it is back, devices in the own Wi-Fi without internet, Wi-Fi guard (alarm on jamming / deauthentication, needs a stick that can listen), adapter list with chip and abilities. Tools page tidied up: groups, every tool folds up and shows its last result. Fix: the Wi-Fi search of the settings works again.

New page "Tools": network scanner (makers, names, warning about new devices, "am I at home" with automatic arming), Wi-Fi surroundings with the best channel, internet test, security check, Bluetooth scanner with tracker warning, focus assistant, servo test, loudspeaker / microphone test, memory card test, diagnosis package without secrets, power calculator.
